newsitem.title: USA: TVI Corp discharged from bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: TVI Corp discharged from bankruptcy.

text.p: TVI Corp said Wednesday that it has completed its reorganization requirements and emerged from bankruptcy court protection.
U.S. Bankruptcy Court entered a final decree and closed the case October 3, TVI said.

The company also said that it and its subsidiary, CD2 Inc, have settled part of a lawsuit against TVI's former president, Brent Molovinsky, and several banks seeking recovery of money allegedly converted by Molovinsky and the banks. The company said it expects about $60,000 from the settlement after paying all legal expenses.
The company, which makes military supplies including portable shelters for the Air Force, has been in bankruptcy since 1991.
It said it is pressing a claim against Molovinsky, who has pleaded guilty to embezzeling more than $800,000.
The company said it expects to obtain a judgment against Molovinsky but that collection on any judgment is uncertain.
